ecovacs robotics - deebot t90s pro omni.description: Built for larger homes with hard floors and carpets, the ECOVACS DEEBOT T90S PRO OMNI brings together intelligent cleaning, added carpet protection, PowerBoost Charging and automated mop and station care. Up to 40,000Pa suction picks up dust, crumbs and pet hair, while ZeroTangle 4.0 helps reduce hair wrap around the brushes. OZMO Roller 3.0 cleans itself in real time as it mops, continuously rinsing the roller with fresh water while a scraper removes dirty water to help reduce smearing and dirt transfer. TruEdge 3.0 extends the roller closer to baseboards and furniture. During carpet cleaning, the roller lifts 0.59 inches and a physical cover separates the wet roller from carpet fibers to help reduce moisture transfer. The OMNI Station automatically empties the dustbin, refills the robot's water tank, dispenses cleaning solution, washes the roller with hot water and dries it with hot air. High-pressure rinsing of the mop-washing tray and automatic dirty-water box cleaning help reduce residue buildup and odors. PowerBoost Charging replenishes the battery during mop washing to help reduce extended charging breaks on larger cleaning jobs. A slim body, LiDAR mapping and AIVI 3D 4.0 with LED-assisted vision help the robot navigate your home, while built-in AGENT YIKO lets you direct cleaning with natural-language voice requests.
